class LogpEval:
    def peakmem_logp_dlogp(self, solver):
        self._logp_dlogp(self._raveled)

    def setup(self, solver):
        from pymc.blocking import DictToArrayBijection
    
        ss_mod = make_configured_statespace(solver=solver)
        self.model = build_pymc_model(ss_mod, synthetic_data())
        self.point = self.model.initial_point()
    
        self._logp = self.model.compile_logp()
        self._dlogp = self.model.compile_dlogp()
        self._logp_dlogp = self.model.logp_dlogp_function()
        self._logp_dlogp.set_extra_values({})
        self._raveled = DictToArrayBijection.map(self.point)
    
        # Warm every compiled function so the timed calls hit no first-call compilation.
        self._logp(self.point)
        self._dlogp(self.point)
        self._logp_dlogp(self._raveled)
estimation.bench_logp_dlogp.LogpEval.pea.name: estimation.bench_logp_dlogp.LogpEval.peakmem_logp_dlogp

solvers.bench_sparse_root.SparseRoot.pea.code:
class SparseRoot:
    def peakmem_solve(self, system_size):
        self._sparse_root(self.fun, self.x0, tol=TOL, maxiter=MAXITER)

    def setup(self, system_size):
        from gEconpy.solvers.sparse_root import sparse_root
    
        self._sparse_root = sparse_root
        rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
        self.x0 = rng.standard_normal(system_size)
    
        # Diagonal dominance keeps the system well-conditioned and the solve deterministic.
        A = sparse.diags(2.0 + rng.random(system_size), format="csc")
        b = rng.standard_normal(system_size)
    
        def fun(x):
            return A @ x - b, A
    
        self.fun = fun

    def time_autocovariance(self, model):
        self._autocovariance_matrix(self.model, T=self.T, R=self.R, shock_std=1.0, n_lags=10)

    def setup(self, model):
        from gEconpy import (
            autocovariance_matrix,
            check_bk_condition,
            impulse_response_function,
            simulate,
            stationary_covariance_matrix,
        )
    
        self.model, self.T, self.R = policy_matrices(model)
        self._stationary_covariance_matrix = stationary_covariance_matrix
        self._autocovariance_matrix = autocovariance_matrix
        self._impulse_response_function = impulse_response_function
        self._simulate = simulate
        self._check_bk_condition = check_bk_condition
